Minimal distinct proposal approved by root: metadata.cpp-only nearest-For lazy field reuse. Binding-slot cutoff identifies dependencies on current loop/inside-let slots; n/b and outer slots invariant for one loop entry. Reset nearest-loop owned Calls on every For entry, then first actually reached Call executes original full evaluation; later executions use only varying top-level fields plus original per-region checks. No per-field generation/atomic checks. Nested calls reset only on their nearest loop entry. Calls outside loops unchanged. max_steps>0 uses exact old evaluator. If branches and empty loops are not eagerly evaluated. Original recursive evaluator preserves int32 intermediate overflow and short circuit; no algebraic rewrite or global CSE. Plan storage counts against BoundProgram. No Metadata/name/hash changes.
Old7de702a was same-call structural CSE; new proposal skips unchanged work across loop iterations with existing scratch outputs, not repeated structural matching. Old screening showed no reliable batch gain; this is a short distinct experiment only.
